EventLinkAdd.comment: Creates a link that other events can use to become a followup Event on a future turn.

Text.comment: Reference to the text-eventOption entry that has the actual option text (shown as 'English Text' above).

HelpText.comment: Reference to the text-eventOption entry that appears as a tooltip when hovering over this option. Usually blank.

zIcon.comment: Icon displayed on the right side of the button.

aeBonuses.comment: List of Bonuses (from either bonus-event.xml or bonus.xml) awarded to each Event Subject in order.

aeTriggers.comment: List of EventTriggers for each Event Subject in order.

PlayerSubject.comment: Requires the Player to be valid for this Subject

PlayerSubjectNotAny.comment: Requires the Player to be not valid for all of these Subjects

LeaderSubject.comment: Requires the Leader to be valid for this Subject

LeaderSubjectAny.comment: Requires the Leader to be valid for one of these Subjects

LeaderSubjectNotAny.comment: Requires the Leader to be not valid for all of these Subjects

IndexSubject.comment: Requires the Subject at this index to meet the requirement of the Subject check. There can be an unlimited number of tests for each Subject. First is the index of the Subject (starting at 0), and Second is the SUBJECT test itself.

IndexSubjectAny.comment: Requires at least one Subject test per index to be valid.

IndexSubjectNotAny.comment: Requires that none of the listed Subject tests be valid.

EventLinkSubjectsAdd.comment: Creates a link that other events can test for the Subjects. The list of ints maps the Event Subjects specified to the parallel indices of the EventLink.

OpenTabOverlay.comment: Selecting this option will open the screen that matches the specified TabOverlayState

iLookAtSubject.comment: The camera looks at this Subject when the option is chosen.

bKeepOpen.comment: If set to 1 (true), selecting this option will not close the event popup

bMainMenu.comment: If set to 1 (true), selecting this option will exit the current game and return to the main menu.

bHidePrereqs.comment: If set to 1 (true), the option text will not display certain prereqs that made this option selectable.

bHideInvalid.comment: If set to 1 (true), the option will be hidden if invalid (and doesn't invalidate the event).

bFutureEvents.comment: If set to 1 (true), this Event will display a generic message hinting that it could lead to future events.

aiEventOptionProb.comment: A paired list of Event options with probability rolls. (Highest roll is the option that is chosen.) If this Event option is possible, it will randomly choose one of the listed Event options.
